passage: Most early photographs required exposures of several minutes, so busy city streets often appeared empty: moving people and carriages left no trace. ______ a man in an 1838 image of a Paris boulevard by Louis Daguerre does appear, because he stood still long enough while having his boots shined.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
steps: Streets usually appeared empty, but this man does appear: an exception worth pointing out.
“Consequently” would make him a result of empty streets; “Likewise” means similarity; “In other words” restates.
key: Ask how the new sentence relates: exception, result, similarity or restatement.
